hints.title: Group Positions by Color
hints.text: Store the indices where each of the colors 1, 2, and 3 appears in sorted position lists.

hints.title: Logarithmic Nearest Neighbor Lookup
hints.text: For a query target index and color, locate the closest position in that color index list using binary division.

hints.title: Evaluate Flanking Indices
hints.text: Check the element at insertion index and insertion index minus 1. Take the minimum absolute difference, or return negative 1 if the color list is empty.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning outward from index for each query takes quadratic O(Q * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorted index arrays per color allow logarithmic closest-neighbor queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement logarithmic nearest-neighbor search checking both left and right adjacent elements.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved using two-pass prefix/suffix arrays in O(N + Q) time.
